commands.purpose: pre-fix baseline; temporarily substitute the unmodified HEAD spec, repeat the exact case five times, and restore the edited spec with a shell trap
commands.command:
bash <<'B15_BASELINE'
set -euo pipefail
repo_root=/root/.kandev/tasks/on-the-stats-page-al_nybnw3z6/kandev
source_file="$repo_root/apps/web/e2e/tests/task/threads-composer-disclosure.spec.ts"
baseline_backup="$(mktemp)"
cp "$source_file" "$baseline_backup"
patched_sha="$(sha256sum "$source_file" | awk '{print $1}')"
restore_owned_spec() {
  local baseline_exit_status=$?
  trap - EXIT
  cp "$baseline_backup" "$source_file"
  local restored_sha
  restored_sha="$(sha256sum "$source_file" | awk '{print $1}')"
  rm -f "$baseline_backup"
  if [[ "$restored_sha" != "$patched_sha" ]]; then
    printf 'owned spec restore mismatch: expected %s, got %s\n' "$patched_sha" "$restored_sha" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  printf 'restored patched spec sha256: %s\n' "$restored_sha"
  exit "$baseline_exit_status"
}
trap restore_owned_spec EXIT
baseline_test_sha="$(git -C "$repo_root" show HEAD:apps/web/e2e/tests/task/threads-composer-disclosure.spec.ts | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
printf 'baseline head: %s\nbaseline spec sha256: %s\npatched spec sha256: %s\n' "$(git -C "$repo_root" rev-parse HEAD)" "$baseline_test_sha" "$patched_sha"
jq '{head,source_commit,status,artifacts,web_rebuilt,backend_includes_reviewed_C6_fix,no_freshness_bypass,freshness_required}' /tmp/usage-history-core-coordinated-host-ready.json
git -C "$repo_root" show HEAD:apps/web/e2e/tests/task/threads-composer-disclosure.spec.ts > "$source_file"
cd "$repo_root/apps/web"
env -u CAPTURE_PR_ASSETS GOMAXPROCS=1 E2E_PORT_OFFSET=24 pnpm e2e:run --host --no-build --project chromium -- e2e/tests/task/threads-composer-disclosure.spec.ts --grep 'zoom 0[.]9, auto-hide true' --workers=1 --retries=0 --repeat-each=5 --output=/tmp/usage-history-B15-baseline
B15_BASELINE
